Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory19.jpg'}
{1: 'Conservation Area, Surface', 2: 'Morning'}
{2: 'Morning. Conservation Area, Surface.'}
{3: 'A storm swept through the conservation area last night. Fortunately, the rain tapered off after sunrise, and calmness has returned to the recently restored area.'}
{3: 'Rainwater drips from buildings, scattering across the ground or striking hollow pipes, making bright, ringing notes. But something else stirs among those sounds.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "...Just as I thought. It's wandered off again.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Lee stares at the rubble he has just overturned. It was a makeshift shelter, but it is now empty. Whatever he is looking for is not here.'}
{2: 'Need a hand, Lee?', 3: '14'}
{2: 'What are you looking for?', 3: '15'}
{2: 'We can figure something out together.', 3: '16'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "A stray cat. It was staying here yesterday, but last night's storm... it couldn't have gone far.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Lee does not want to waste time being indecisive. He had other plans, but the cat's injuries haven't healed yet, so he cannot leave it alone."}
{2: 'The storm probably spooked it into hiding.', 3: '19'}
{2: "Let's try something to draw it out.", 3: '20'}
{2: 'Meow at it.', 3: '22', 4: 'Lure it with food.', 5: '35'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'Are you being serious?', 4: '1'}
{2: "Yes. It's a pretty common way to lure a cat.", 3: '24'}
{3: 'Lee reluctantly lets out a sound so faint that it is barely audible.'}
{2: "The cat can't hear you if you're that quiet.", 3: '28'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "The cat can't hear me, or you can't hear me?", 4: '1'}
{2: "That's beside the point. What if I join you? Meow—", 3: '31', 4: 'The cat, for real. Finding it should be our priority.', 5: '31'}
{3: 'Lee falls silent for a moment, seemingly weighing whether you were being genuine or mischievous. But it does not really matter at the end of the day.'}
{3: 'Lee eventually gives in.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "I'm not sure if it'll work on this cat... but it's worth a shot, given the circumstances.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Lee pulls out some food he has prepared for today's visit. The aroma spreads through the air, and sure enough, you notice some movement from a nearby corner."}
{3: 'Seeing this, Lee walks over to the corner and crouches down, offering the food. Only then does the creature hiding inside finally show itself.'}
{3: 'A scrawny kitten darts out from the shadows, letting out a meow as if to reassure Lee. But it does not approach, keeping its distance from both of you.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "It must've been injured by something before. It's really wary of humans.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "I've been taking care of it for a few days now, but I still can't get it to trust me. I thought maybe you'd have better luck, but now...", 4: '2'}
{2: "What made you think I'd have better luck with it?", 3: '53'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "—Just running through the facts and eliminating variables. I deduced that the reason it wouldn't warm up to anyone... might be me.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "I thought maybe you'd seem less intimidating to it... But I guess it treats us both the same.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Lee looks at the kitten with a hint of worry, but it just responds with another indignant meow.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "...Stop it already. You've still got a wound on your leg that needs treatment. Come here and let me take care of it.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Kitten', 3: 'Meow? Meow meow!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "Stop moving. If you stay put, I'll take that as you consenting to the treatment.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The kitten seems to understand Lee perfectly. It hisses once before scampering off to a safe distance, clearly not about to cooperate.'}
{2: 'What should we do now?', 3: '71'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "Let's reinforce the shelter I built for it first. There might be more rain on the way, so at least it'll have somewhere to take cover.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'You two crouch down to reinforce the rickety shelter, unaware of the movement behind you. A pair of gleaming eyes watches from the shadows, fixed on the food Lee has set aside.'}
{2: 'Rat', 3: 'Squeak—!'}
{3: 'A dark gray rat darts out and charges straight toward Lee. Having survived in this place for so long, it has clearly lost its fear of humans.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}

{3: "Lee senses the commotion immediately and pulls you close, shielding you with his arm. By the time he turns to face the intruder, the rat is already clamped tight in the kitten's jaws, struggling helplessly."}
{3: "The kitten's patience runs out quickly. It clamps down harder, biting until the rat stops moving altogether."}

{3: "Once the rat is neutralized, the kitten pads forward and drops it at Lee's feet, glancing at him with a look of casual indifference before sitting down to groom its paws with smug satisfaction."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "...How pointless. I'm perfectly capable of handling a rat on my own.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'You protected me like it protected you.', 3: '100'}
{2: "That rat wasn't a threat to me either.", 3: '101'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "I wasn't thinking about that. It was just instinct. There's no point in taking unnecessary risks when they can be avoided.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Lee', 3: "Even if it didn't hurt you, you could have cut yourself with all the sharp metal debris lying around or picked up some kind of virus. It'd be a hassle to deal with, no matter what.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bottom line is, you care about me, Lee.', 3: '104', 4: "I know. I'd do the same for you instinctively.", 5: '105'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: '...I never said otherwise.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "...Of course I know you'd do the same. But it's best I handle things like this.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Lee glances at the nearby kitten and extends his hand toward it once it finishes grooming. The kitten does not flinch this time, padding forward and rubbing its head against his fingers after a brief pause.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Seeing the kitten has warmed up to him, Lee carefully lifts it into his arms and tends to the wound on its hind leg.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "It shouldn't be afraid of being touched anymore. Want to come pet it?", 4: '1'}
{3: "You gladly accept Lee's offer and carefully reach out toward the kitten. Perhaps it has picked up Lee's scent on you; it does not shy away, docilely allowing you to stroke it."}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'You seem to be feeling better. Looks like bringing you here to see it was the right call.', 4: '1'}
{2: "It's you that's making me feel better, Lee.", 3: '120', 4: 'The person keeping me company deserves credit too.', 5: '120'}
{2: 'Because I saw your hard work pay off.', 3: '121'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "...It's not because of the kitten? I thought it was because you liked cats.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Is that why you brought me here, Lee?', 3: '124'}
{3: 'Something clicks in your mind. You think for a moment before you continue.'}
{2: 'Pick up the kitten, Lee.', 3: '126'}
{3: 'Confused, Lee still does as you asked. Holding the kitten, he stands up and looks at you with a puzzled expression.'}
{2: "Move a little closer. Yeah, that's it.", 3: '132'}
{3: 'Lee holds the kitten close, and you look at both of them: the similar color of their hair, the almost-identical gaze... It slowly dawns on Lee what you are getting at.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "Don't tell me... You think I look like this kitten... So when you said you liked it, you actually meant—", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He cannot bring himself to finish the sentence, but you both know what is implied.'}

{3: 'At some point, the clouds part completely, and sunlight breaks through for the first time in days, bathing the rain-washed earth and the kitten. It mews contentedly, basking in this moment of peace.'}
{2: 'It really likes you.', 3: '141'}
{3: 'Lee glances down at the little creature now settled in his arms, and he has to admit that they really look alike. He steps closer to you with a soft smile, bringing the kitten near.'}
{3: 'He pauses briefly, but does not hesitate for long before speaking again, his voice soft.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'It really likes you too.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A gentle breeze stirs. The kitten mews again, soft and content, as if giving voice to words left unspoken.'}
